sections.title: Invoices
sections.content: Invoices are available in account portal under Billing. For invoice corrections, verify order details before reissuing. Do not modify billed amounts without billing system verification.

sections.title: Payment Failures
sections.content: Payment failures due to insufficient funds must be retried by customer. Agent may provide payment troubleshooting steps but must not store card details manually.

sections.title: Subscription Cancellation
sections.content: Subscriptions can be cancelled anytime effective next billing cycle. No prorated refund unless required by law or explicit promotion terms. Agent must confirm cancellation and provide confirmation.
